reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about HEA coating behavior, oxide formation mechanisms, and performance under extreme conditions, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support any of these premises.

HEA multi-component structure leads to in-situ formation of diverse, low-diffusivity oxide particles
